description: Fleet fuel monitoring — consumption, cost, refuelling, theft events and fuel-efficiency ranking.

dataSource.subtitle: How efficiently the fleet is burning fuel right now.
dataSource.ariaLabel: Fuel efficiency score — the fleet score out of 100.
dataSource.emptyText: No fuel efficiency score for the selected filters.

dataSource.subtitle: Current tank level per vehicle, fullest first.
dataSource.ariaLabel: Fleet fuel levels — horizontal bar chart of the current tank level as a percentage for ten vehicles, ranked fullest first.
dataSource.emptyText: No fuel levels reported for the selected filters.

dataSource.subtitle: Does fuel use track the distance driven, day by day?
dataSource.ariaLabel: Fuel consumed over distance — dual-axis line chart with fuel in litres on the leading axis and distance in kilometres on the trailing axis.
dataSource.emptyText: No fuel or distance data for the selected filters.

dataSource.subtitle: How much of the fuel put into tanks is actually burned?
dataSource.ariaLabel: Fuel dispensed versus fuel burned — line chart comparing two litre series.
dataSource.emptyText: No fuel data for the selected filters.

dataSource.subtitle: Where refuelling, low-fuel and theft events happened.
dataSource.ariaLabel: Fuel monitoring events — map of twelve refuelling, low-fuel and fuel-theft events across Abu Dhabi.
dataSource.emptyText: No fuel events in the selected period.

dataSource.subtitle: Daily fuel spend across the selected month.
dataSource.ariaLabel: Monthly fuel cost — column chart of daily fuel spend in dirhams.
dataSource.emptyText: No fuel cost for the selected filters.

dataSource.subtitle: Daily count of refuelling events.
dataSource.ariaLabel: Refueling over time — column chart of daily refuelling events.

dataSource.subtitle: Drivers whose fuel efficiency and event count need attention.
